projectSummaries.allostat: What if intelligence grows from having something at stake? Agents that improve themselves, driven by homeostatic imperatives, with no central controller.
projectSummaries.i3ai: Exploring the gap between intelligence and feeling, and what it would take for a machine to have a stake of its own.
projectSummaries.pattern-machine: How do patterns emerge from experience? An ongoing exploration of local learning in spiking neural networks.
projectSummaries.ragafied: An idea from 2012, rebuilt for today. Turn a recording into something you can sing back to, one phrase at a time.
projectSummaries.agentapplication: A shared architecture for persistent agents that use tools, keep a workspace, and build things that last.
